# Product Expert: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-20 · code 4d32d5275b3a · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Free director of product training and certificates: strategy, experiments, metrics, pricing, the P&L, org design, executive influence and AI products.
**Live:** https://productexpert.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/productexpert · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/productexpert/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py productexpert` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Readiness Check** (#check): Check.py records each answer in the server session before revealing it (reveal_check), and save_check scores only those, so 16/16 can't be faked. ITEM_IDS order is part of what old codes mean: append, don't reorder.
- **Red Pen Studio** (#studio): the rules are client_code/redpen.py, imported by the browser AND by server_code/Studio.py (one package); keep it pure Python without `re`. test_server.py copies it into the mock app. "My own" mode never calls the server.
- **Interview Day** (#loop): Loops.finish_loop records each round via Learning._record_attempt (split out of submit_challenge), so loop answers show under their challenges and count toward modules.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **attempts**: user→users, challenge:str, module:str, answer:str, points:obj, score:num, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Learning
- **bookmarks**: user→users, ref:str, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Curriculum
- **card_state**: user→users, item:str, module:str, box:num, due:date, reviews:num, lapses:num, last:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Curriculum, DemoData, Exams, Learning
- **checks**: code:str, user→users, score:num, by_track:obj, missed:obj, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Check, DemoData
- **credentials**: user→users, track:str, code:str, holder:str, issued:dt, score:num, revoked:bool, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Credentials, Curriculum, DemoData, Exams, Learning
- **error_log**: when:dt, source:str, kind:str, message:str, traceback:str, page:str, session:str, user→users
- **exams**: user→users, track:str, started:dt, finished:dt, card_score:num, scenario_score:num, passed:bool, detail:obj, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Exams
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **lab_runs**: user→users, lab:str, score:num, detail:obj, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Labs
- **loops**: user→users, fmt:str, rounds:obj, started:dt, finished:dt, verdict:str, score:num, is_demo:bool · used in Loops
- **module_progress**: user→users, module:str, read_at:dt, challenge_score:num, completed_at:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Curriculum, DemoData, Learning
- **studio_docs**: user→users, kind:str, brief:str, title:str, doc:obj, score:num, grade:str, created:dt, updated:dt, xp_awarded:bool, is_demo:bool · used in Studio
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str, xp:num, streak:num, last_study:date, job_title:str, honour_roll:bool, plan:obj, remembered_logins:obj · used in Admin, DemoData

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/session_test.py`: Expired-session test: the app must reload quietly (same page, still signed in, typed text kept) ins…
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
